name: Nadeshiko
source:
The landlady of “Sakyuu-wa So-Sou,” where Souji ended up living. An ageless beauty. Seeking someone to support the three underachievers in becoming proper succubi, she sets her sights on Souji.

She's always smiling and has the gentle demeanor of a dependable older sister, but she also has a side where she uses her voluptuous body to drain men's vitality completely, calling it “snacking.”

She seems to have several side jobs that combine her hobbies with practical benefits...

[From [url=http://clockup.net/scap/]official site[/url]]
